role: Fresh independent reviewer, not the figure author

imageOpens.observation: One schematic: three thin approximately horizontal rightward field strokes with three arrowheads; the middle ends before the other two. One thick rising-right plane-edge stroke crosses all three and extends above and below them. A descending-right normal arrow shares the middle field/edge intersection, crosses the lower field and ends below it. The short curved sector is between the middle rightward field ray and normal, with alpha to its right. B is between the top and middle field lines near their right ends; n is below the normal near its tip. Both letters have overhead rightward vector accents. No visible point markers, grid, numerical angle, S label, closed loop, filled plane or other instructional annotation.

Both B and n have complete overhead rightward arrows, not missing-glyph boxes or detached adjacent arrows. Alpha and its small sector are clear. Three field arrowheads, the normal arrowhead, all three plane crossings and the lower normal crossing remain intact. All three labels are separate from strokes and each other; nothing clips.

The full B/n letter-and-accent clusters are visible. The middle field endpoint remains shorter, the heavy edge crosses all three field strokes, and the down-right normal shares the middle origin and crosses the lower field. Alpha is not confused with the field/plane angle. No clipping, label collision or new point markers.

Both vector accents, all four directional arrowheads, the plane-edge endpoints and all required crossings are visible. Alpha remains clear between the relevant rays. The label clusters do not touch the shafts, arc or canvas boundary. No added loop, filled surface, S, formula or numerical angle.

At the maximum declared width the complete vector arrows over B/n and alpha are clean. Exact schematic edge/normal orthogonality is apparent without an added right-angle marker. The four arrowheads and stroke crossings are intact; labels, arc and shafts do not overlap or clip.

The narrow Chinese native preview has the same complete B/n overhead arrows, alpha, geometry and unclipped endpoints as the English 310 preview. Bilingual paragraph/caption language does not change figure notation. No missing-glyph box or collision.

sourceFactsVersusModernization.sourceFacts: Stroke counts, rightward/down-right directions, relative field endpoint ordering, shared origin, three plane crossings, lower normal crossing, alpha-sector meaning, three label bodies and two vector accents.
justifiedModernRegularization: Exact horizontal parallelism and equal spacing, smooth strokes, canvas coordinates, lengths, weights and precise illustrative angle opening are not measurements from source pixels.

Exact perpendicularity of the normal and plane edge is warranted by the unchanged edition text's normal-to-plane meaning. It is not a measured source angle and creates no new numerical given or acute-angle condition.
A circular minor arc and invisible construction endpoints/intersections regularize the source sector. Hidden points are not new visible source points.

U+20D7 is a modern text-cluster implementation of the observed accents, not a recovered source codepoint. Upright native B/n typography replaces irregular slanted source print without changing the notation.
sourceFactsVersusModernization.extras: None. No source noise, point markers, grid, closed loop, filled plane, S label, projection line, equation, solution, numerical angle, right-angle marker or cultural decoration.
